one_line: Rajput court painter of the Mewar school, active in early 17th-century Chawand and Udaipur ateliers.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, slim but sturdy build, slightly ink-stained hands of a working artist.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, faint worry line between brows, default expression calm and focused with sharp, observant eyes.
appearance.hair: Black hair tied in a small low knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a soft white cotton turban wrapped close to the skull with one narrow tail tucked behind the left ear and a thin red headband peeking at the base.
appearance.costume: A long-sleeved knee-length angarkha in soft off-white cotton with a subtle fine red block-printed border along the opening and cuffs, tied at the right side with visible red cords; beneath, a plain light-cream churidar with tight folds at the ankles; over the shoulders a narrow saffron-colored cotton patka (sash) with slim green edge stripes, worn diagonally from left shoulder to right hip; at the waist, a simple woven red-and-cream cloth belt knotted slightly off-center; on his feet, brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; minimal jewellery—one thin silver bangle on the right wrist and a small, simple silver stud earring in each ear.
appearance.signature: A rectangular red-lacquered wooden portfolio held under his left arm, its edge showing stacked manuscript folios, and in his right hand a slender squirrel-hair painting brush with a bamboo handle stained dark near the tip.

ref_desc: Sahibdin is a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his late 30s with a short beard, black hair in a knot under a close white turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, light-cream churidar, saffron patka, red belt and brown mojari, carrying a red wooden portfolio and a slim brush.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sahibdin, a dignified early 17th-century Mewar court painter: a slim, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, sharp observant eyes, and a short neat beard and moustache, his black hair tied in a small low knot and mostly covered by a soft white cotton turban wrapped close to the skull with one narrow tail tucked behind his left ear and a thin red headband peeking at the base. Dress him in a long-sleeved knee-length off-white cotton angarkha with a fine red block-printed border along the opening and cuffs, tied on the right side with red cords, over a plain light-cream churidar showing tight folds at the ankles. Let a narrow saffron-colored cotton patka with slim green edge stripes run diagonally from his left shoulder to his right hip, secured by a simple woven red-and-cream cloth belt knotted slightly off-center at the waist. Put brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes on his feet, and add subtle jewellery: one thin silver bangle on his right wrist and small silver stud earrings. In his left arm tuck a rectangular red-lacquered wooden portfolio whose edge reveals stacked manuscript folios, and in his right hand place a slender squirrel-hair painting brush with a dark-stained bamboo handle, posed as if pausing thoughtfully between strokes. Emphasize the consistent palette of off-white, saffron, red, light cream and brown, and show front, side and back views to clearly display his turban, angarkha, patka, belt, churidar, mojari and his portfolio-and-brush combination.
